text:
QUOTE: "installs its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` and `buffer_alloc_free` through `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator installs itself via the setter from its init function. It never says it is the only in-tree user of the setter, and the item needs that "only user" claim.
